label: Dynastic cycle monthly pulse
summary: Going by its name, a monthly hook for the dynastic cycle (a situation, the game's long-running political scenario), which script fires itself.
details: Vanilla defines it with an empty effect, so by itself it does nothing. Mods can add their own effects to it. The game's code does not fire it, and the game names no root. That it runs monthly rests on the name only.

label: Dynastic cycle yearly pulse
summary: A yearly hook for the dynastic cycle situation, fired by script, that rewards legitimacy and triggers situation catalysts.
details: In the part of the definition the input shows, while the situation is in its chaos phase, each participant who can change legitimacy gains 1 legitimacy for holding the Chinese capital county, legitimacy equal to the tier of each kingdom-or-higher title they hold in the Chinese hegemony, and 1 more for each of three groups of meritorious people (court position holders, councillors, governors) that is at least half of their kind with merit level 6 or more. After that it triggers a yearly catalyst for whichever movement (expansion, advancement and others) is in power. The input is cut off, so later parts are not covered.

label: Ecumenical council summons events
summary: Picks one random event for a playable character during the prelude phase of an ecumenical council (a church council).
details: Only runs for playable characters. The pool is a weighted list: secrets about other guests or the Pope, hooks on the Pope, court chaplain trouble, slander about piety, four rite quarrels (Papal Authority, the Filioque, Liturgy, Cultural Barriers), and several flavour events. Script fires it; the game's code does not.

label: El Cid landless events
summary: Picks one random event for the landless stage of the El Cid story cycle.
details: Vanilla's comment labels this pool as the landless one. The events are: nobody opens the door to you, you cannot pay your men, or you must leave your family behind. The weights are 200, 100 and 200. Script fires it.

label: El Cid landless or landed events
summary: Picks one random event for a character in the El Cid story cycle, whether or not they hold land.
details: The events are: sending a gift with spare money, praying for your liege, or your liege offering a favourable marriage (weights 100, 100 and 250). Two more El Cid events are noted in comments as fired from the combat on_action instead. Script fires it.

label: Elope scheme ongoing
summary: Picks a random event while a character is planning to elope with someone, fired by script during the scheme.
details: It needs a scheme saved as scope:scheme. Only about 20 percent of the time anything is chosen. The pool holds generic intrigue scheme events (paying gold for progress, agents slipping up, finding a secret), one elope event where the lover doubts, and a few lifestyle events. A comment says the generic part is shared with the murder and abduct schemes.

label: Akolouthos events
summary: Picks a random event for a landed ruler who employs an akolouthos (a Byzantine court position) who is able to act.
details: Needs the Roads to Power content, the court position filled by a physically able adult who is not a player, and a landed ruler. Each run has a 33 percent chance to give an event: the akolouthos enforces oaths, or recruits a Varangian. Script fires it.

label: Bountiful harvest contract
summary: Creates a Bountiful Harvest task contract (a job the game hands out for a province) at the capital province.
details: It is skipped if the character carries the cooldown flag for it, which lasts 10 years after the contract is created. Farmland or floodplain in the sub-realm makes it more likely, and a realm with only rough terrain makes it less likely. The contract's tier is read from scope:governance_task_contract_tier, so something has to save that scope before this runs. The game doc lists no root scope.

label: Buried treasure contract
summary: Creates a Buried Treasure task contract in a province with a holding that someone other than the governor owns.
details: Skipped while the 10-year cooldown flag is on the character. The province is picked at random from the sub-realm's counties. The contract tier is read from scope:governance_task_contract_tier, and the script also reads scope:governor, so both must be set before it runs.

label: Contract 0094 travel fallback
summary: Reopens the task contract event ep3_contract_event.0094 with a variable set, so the player sees the same options again.
details: Vanilla's own comment says it covers a player escaping out of the event without starting their travel properly. Without it the options would be randomized every time the event reopens. It sets the variable contract_094_travel_fallback_true, then triggers the event. Script fires it.

label: Discontent soldiers contract
summary: Creates a Discontent Soldiers task contract at the capital province.
details: Only when the character does not have the 10-year cooldown flag and has at least 2 men-at-arms regiments that come from a title and are not currently raised. The tier is read from scope:governance_task_contract_tier, which the caller sets.

label: Evil presence contract
summary: Creates an Evil Presence task contract in a Christian county of the sub-realm that has a holding owned by someone other than the governor.
details: Only for the low contract tier, and not while the 10-year cooldown flag is on the character. The province is chosen at random among the matching ones.

label: Hoarding mayor contract
summary: Creates a Hoarding Mayor task contract in a city holding whose owner, not the governor, has at least 500 gold.
details: The owner of that province becomes the contract's employer. Skipped while the 10-year cooldown flag is on the character. The county is picked at random among the matching ones.

label: Hungry times contract
summary: Creates a Hungry Times task contract in a province that carries the variable epidemic_cooldown_general.
details: The province needs a holding owned by someone other than the governor and that variable, which vanilla's comment ties to epidemics. The cooldown flag on the character lasts 15 years, because the comment says the epidemic cooldown also lasts 15 years and the game should not pick the same place twice in a row.

label: Inept mayor contract
summary: Creates an Inept Mayor task contract in a city holding whose owner, not the governor, has stewardship at or below mediocre.
details: The owner becomes the contract's employer, and the county gets the modifier ep3_mismanaged_administration_modifier for 10 years. Skipped while the 10-year cooldown flag is on the character.

label: Mad prophet contract
summary: Creates a Mad Prophet task contract in a province with a holding owned by someone other than the governor.
details: Skipped while the 10-year cooldown flag is on the character. The province is picked at random in the sub-realm.

label: Miraculous healing contract
summary: Creates a Miraculous Healing task contract at the capital province.
details: The only condition is that the 10-year cooldown flag is not on the character. The contract's tier is read from scope:governance_task_contract_tier.

label: Overdue taxes contract
summary: Creates an Overdue Taxes task contract in a province with a holding that is not the governor's capital.
details: Skipped while the 10-year cooldown flag is on the character. The province is picked at random from the sub-realm.

label: Provincial investment contract
summary: Creates a Provincial Investment task contract at the capital province, only for the high contract tier.
details: Skipped while the 10-year cooldown flag is on the character. A character with the education_stewardship trait gets +10 to its weight.

label: Public land contract
summary: Creates a Public Land task contract about a province where an AI character's estate stands, with that estate owner as the employer.
details: The governor must own an estate in the sub-realm, and either a castle holding of someone else or an AI-owned estate must exist. Skipped during the 10-year cooldown. The input is cut off, so the rest of the effect is not covered.

label: Raiding peasants contract
summary: Creates a Raiding Peasants task contract in a county that borders land of another top liege and has a holding.
details: Skipped while the 10-year cooldown flag is on the character. The county and province are picked at random among the matching ones.

label: Rampant bandits contract
summary: Gives a county of the sub-realm the modifier ep3_governance_rampant_bandits for 40 years and picks a province in it as the target.
details: Counties with low county control (how firmly the holder controls the county) are favoured when picking, and empty baronies, then cities, then temples are favoured for the province. The chance of the on_action itself rises with many low-control counties and falls to a tenth when none is at 90 or below. The input is cut off, so the contract itself is not shown; going by the key and the other contract on_actions it creates a Rampant Bandits contract.

label: Restored Rome events
summary: Picks a random event for a character whom the Roman restoration events cover (going by the name, the ruler of a restored Roman Empire).
details: There is a 10 percent chance each run. The events are an inefficient governor causing a loss of popular opinion, a random kingdom raiding you, and a Mongol invasion (weights 100, 100 and 20). A plague event is commented out. Script fires it.

label: Titles for sale contract
summary: Creates a Titles for Sale task contract at the capital province.
details: Only if the faith does not have the temporal head doctrine and the rite does not have the lay clergy theocracy doctrine. Skipped during the 10-year cooldown.

label: Wartime measures contract
summary: Creates a Wartime Measures task contract at the capital province while the liege is at war and the character is not.
details: The vassal contract must also carry the frontier or military administration theme flag. Skipped during the 10-year cooldown.

label: Wild predators contract
summary: Creates a Wild Predators task contract in a county with hunting grounds, a royal forest, forest or jungle.
details: The county gets the modifier ep3_wild_predators_modifier for 10 years. Provinces with hunting grounds or a royal forest are preferred, with forest and jungle as the fallback. Skipped during the 10-year cooldown.

label: Administrative yearly events
summary: Picks a random yearly event for a character under an administrative government.
details: Each year there is a 50 percent chance of an event. The pool is split into events for the emperor, for governors, for powerful families, for landless house heads, and story cycles (Grand Ambitions, the admin eunuch). Script fires it.

label: Landless adventurer yearly events
summary: Picks a yearly event for a landless adventurer who is free to act.
details: Needs the Roads to Power content, the landless adventurer government and not being imprisoned. If the character is part of an activity, its current phase must not be active and the character must not be at the activity's location. The pool covers camp life, children, tensions between followers and more, with heavy weights on some child events. The input is cut off after the camp events, so the rest is not covered.

label: Epidemic ongoing events
summary: Picks a random event about an epidemic and also applies epidemic effects to the ruler.
details: No event is one more weight (95) in the pool, set against many events of weight 100 and less. The pool has general plague events, event chains and physician events. The effect part causes a legitimacy loss when the capital's infection rate reaches 100 (at most once per 2 years), and triggers a Black Death splash screen for an apocalyptic bubonic plague. It reads scope:epidemic. The input is cut off, so later parts are not covered.

label: Escape from prison attempt
summary: Fires the event prison.9000 when a prisoner tries to escape.
details: Vanilla's comment calls it the escape attempt. The result is not decided here: vanilla has separate success and failure on_actions, but the input does not show what fires them. Script fires it.

label: Escape from prison failure
summary: Picks a random event for a prisoner whose escape failed.
details: Events: still stuck, the prison pet fails, a friend or family member leaves you behind, the imprisoner's shieldmaiden stops you, a rival sabotages it, or you are wounded. The weights run from 5 to 200. Script fires it.

label: Escape from prison success
summary: Picks a random event for a prisoner who escaped.
details: Events: a plain escape (weight 1), escape thanks to the prison pet (100) or escaping together with a friend or close family member (100). Script fires it.

label: Fabricate hook method success
summary: Picks one of five outcome events, going by the name for when a fabricate-hook scheme method succeeds.
details: Each has weight 100: a compromised situation you set up, a fabricated letter, a rescue from thugs you hired, countering a rumour you started, or threatening their life. Script fires it.

label: Fabricate hook ongoing
summary: Picks a random event while a character is working on a fabricate-hook scheme.
details: Needs a scheme saved as scope:scheme, and the character not travelling. There is only a 5 percent chance of an event, and the pool also has a weight-100 empty entry. Events include asking a family member for help, learning from someone with leverage, spreading rumours, and generic agent events.

label: Faith heresy pulse
summary: Can start a heresy in a faith when its fervor (religious zeal) is low, by firing heresy_pulse.0001.
details: Needs fervor of 40 or less, no unreformed doctrine and no heresy already running. Vanilla's comment says the chance per month rises sharply as fervor falls, roughly 1, 3, 8 and 30 percent across the fervor range, and is also changed by the Christian situation phase. The root is a faith. Script fires it.

label: Holy order land pulse
summary: Lets a faith's military holy orders ask for land, by firing holy_order.1000.
details: Needs a military holy order in the faith. Each run has a 17 percent chance to pick an event (a comment says roughly every six months). Each order and each suitable ruler lowers the weight of no event by 5, down to a minimum of 30, while 80 is added when no military order has fewer leased titles than its soft threshold. The root is a faith.

label: Monastic order land pulse
summary: Lets a faith's monastic holy orders ask for land, by firing holy_order.1010.
details: The same as the military holy order version, but for monastic orders, with its own request check for rulers and a weight of 600 for the event instead of 500. The root is a faith.

label: Rite growth extra chance pulse
summary: Gives a faith an extra small chance to grow a new rite, by firing rite_growth.0001.
details: Blocked for unreformed doctrines, the game rule that turns branched rites off, a recent fallback spawn or a recent heresy. The faith must be below its soft maximum of rites, have enough county followers and the game must be at least 2 years old. The chance to happen is 1 percent, and no event has weight 90 against 100 for the event. A comment says it has a shorter cooldown than the main pulse.

label: Rite growth pulse
summary: Gives a faith a chance to grow a new rite, by firing rite_growth.0001.
details: Blocked for unreformed doctrines, the game rule that turns branched rites off, a recent spawn or a recent heresy. It needs the faith to need more rites and the game to be at least 2 years old. There is a 3 percent chance, and the no-event weight depends on fervor and on how many rites are needed.

label: Feast default events
summary: Picks a random feast event for a character who is a ruler.
details: The pool is large: intent events (ambush, seduce, befriend, murder), self-triggered, target-triggered, relation and host-triggered events, and warfare lifestyle events. Some entries repeat ids, such as feast_default.1012 and 1014. The input is cut off after the warfare lifestyle events, so later parts are not covered.
